# Wood Fountain Pens

> A Brooklyn-based maker of handcrafted wood and brass fountain pens offering luxury writing instruments, professional gifts, and comprehensive pen care resources.

Wood Fountain Pens specializes in artisanal fountain pens crafted from exotic hardwoods like wenge, ebony, and cherry, combined with brass components. The company serves both individual collectors and corporate clients seeking premium writing instruments and bulk gifting solutions.

## Key Topics

- Handmade fountain pens
- Wood and brass construction
- The Hemmingway pen
- Exotic hardwoods
- Luxury writing instruments
- Fountain pen maintenance
- Corporate gifts
- Professional image

- Genius Iridium nib
- Brooklyn artisan
- Customer service

## Products & Collections

- [All Products](https://woodfountainpens.com/collections/all-products): Complete product catalog featuring fountain pens and leather accessories
- [The Hemmingway | Handmade Wood and Brass Fountain Pen](https://woodfountainpens.com/products/wood-fountain-pen): Flagship handmade fountain pen with Genius Iridium nib, crafted from exotic hardwoods and brass
